name: Hoshizuki's Father
source:
The father of [url=https://vndb.org/c76033]Souma[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c74120]Ena[/url]. He is very busy with his work and often comes back late in the evening, just like his [url=https://vndb.org/c76035]wife[/url]. 

They think that their daughter are a quiet and kind girl and do not suspect she is actually an easy girl.
